title: Vendor Data Handling Policy
summary: Any vendor with access to personal data of employees, customers, or partners must have a written data protection clause aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, including breach notification within 72 hours.

title: Liability Cap Guidance
summary: Standard vendor contracts should cap aggregate liability at 12 months of fees paid. Any deviation below this floor, or any uncapped liability clause, requires senior legal sign-off before execution.

title: Termination Rights Guidance
summary: All vendor and service agreements must include a termination-for-convenience right with a notice period between 30 and 90 days, and a termination-for-cause right with a cure period of at least 30 days.

title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution Guidance
summary: Domestic vendor agreements should specify Indian governing law and an Indian arbitration seat unless the vendor is a critical foreign supplier, in which case regional legal must approve the alternate jurisdiction.

title: Confidentiality Survival Guidance
summary: Confidentiality obligations should survive contract termination for at least 5 years for commercially sensitive information. Shorter survival periods should be escalated for business justification.
